description: Trinkwasser Versorgungsgebiete Thüringen is a dataset listed in German national open data portal (GovData), an open data portal, published or maintained by GDI-DE. In Thüringen sind für die Sicherung einer qualitäts- und quantitätsgerechten Trinkwasserversorgung die Städte und Gemeinden zuständig. Größtenteils haben sich diese zu Wasserversorgungszweckverbänden zusammengeschlossen oder organisieren es selbst. Der thüringenweite Datensatz enthält die Verbands- bzw. Versorgungsgebiete mit weiteren Informationen zu den entsprechenden verantwortlichen Stellen. Coverage: GDI-DE. The portal files it under the publisher GDI-DE. Its tags are opendata, thüringen, trinkwasser, ver--und-entsorgung, versorgungsgebiete. It offers 1 resource(s) in SHP. The portal shows 2026-07-22 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-de-portal.
